notes.title: Final Version Windows & Linux
notes.notes:
- If everything is correct (which it rarely is) the game is available for Linux and therefore also supposedly on SteamDeck, as I don't have SteamDeck I will appreciate as always any hint on whether it works or not.

- Multiplayer will not be an option, I couldn't implement it by doing it myself or hiring someone (a total disaster).

Some features of this latest update are;

- Chamuco's ending in Kmx mode.
- Some lackluster Ex movements were retouched such as Gaspar's Impulse Attack or Zonzo among others.
- Many visual effects were added and the possibility of select the color of a character by choosing it with Enter or Intro (although it is not reflected in the menu).
- Various bug fixes.

Thanks to everyone, it has been a hard but satisfactory experience.

notes.title: November 23th Update
notes.notes:
IMPORTANT: This Update includes Kombate Mexicano X style gameplay, now two players must be selected to play, therefore a lot of bugs are sure to be expected since it's just the beginning. There is not Story yet, however, the game can be played in all modes. To select this mode, click on the X in the Title, the background will shift to green.

Update Log.

- Charging moves are corrected again, now the charge is not lost if the button is pressed for long.
- Cagualderón, Rigoletto and el Mandilón y su Vieja's various boxes are corrected.
- Controller and/or Keyboard configuration is simplified in the Configuration Menu.
- English language revisited, various gramatical and typing errors are corrected.
- Pepe Nando's peste move is not longer an infinite.
- The Attacking Character is pushed back if the opponent is cornered.
- El Kevin does not lose armor if thrown.

I'm currently working on multiplayer mode, so it could be a while for the next update.

notes.title: October 27th Update
notes.notes:
- Jumping programming is changed so it feels smooth.
- Armored moves Bug correction. Armor is lost if thrown
- Music between matches is out, it caused long loading times.
- Little tweak in horizontal charged moves.
- Pausing during a shake of screen not longer causes the screen to keep shaking.
- The tutorial is not longer mandatory in Story Mode but rather an option instead of Practice(New players should try it).
- In Button Configuration the instruction that indicates which key to press blinks. It auto-updates itself if changed.
- To play as Player 1 Enter or Space keys are allowed aside of F1.
- To play as Player 2 Right Enter key is allowed aside of 7.
- Holgazano loses the Ultra bar if hit while Tronco.
- Yasabesquién as a boss has Ultra since the beginning.
- Windowed and Full Screen are available by pressing the F key. 

Please share any bug or anything else that need correction.

notes.title: October 15th Update
notes.notes:
- More gameplay information in Tutorial.
- A bit of optimization in loading times.
- Return to Game and Configuration change places in Pause Menu.
- Life bars now get empty toward the center.
- Wrong hit stars don't show anymore.
- If an opponent receives Ataque Derribador(the Knockdown Attack) while Ex is active and has armor property, they experience a rough reaction.
- Ma. María's Oranges and Nopal do not lose "Life Time" during hit stars or during a Super/Ultra.
- Yasabesquién's AI sets its difficulty to the maximum regardless of what`s been selected in Settings.

notes.title: September 30th Changes
notes.notes:
- It can be played with two controllers (always have updated drivers).
- Correction and addition of texts.
- TeclasEx by Deborah Cesta does not connect a fallen rival.
- Tutorial improvements, font change, no time limit, you can no longer control the opponent.
